name: @pcc/resource-tracker
description: Offline, in-memory transactional resource/capacity tracker: calibrated capacity model that refuses out-of-bounds requests + a 2-phase reserve/commit/rollback ledger + typed refuse-to-start errors. Clean-room port of the PyLabRobot poka-yoke pattern (https://github.com/PyLabRobot/pylabrobot) — pattern reference only, no dependency on pylabrobot.
